knownCaveats: Name any stateful/order-dependent case here, e.g.: 'auth/verify-otp/01 depends on auth/request-otp/01 having run first for the same identifier.'

confluence.notes: Omit this whole confluence block if the product has nowhere to publish results — testing-api skips that step when it's absent.

api.notes: 'client' is one of "bruno", "postman", "insomnia" and picks which testing-api adapter runs this collection — everything else in this block has the same meaning regardless of client. For Postman, collectionPath should point at a directory containing both the *.postman_collection.json file and an environments/ folder of *.postman_environment.json files, mirroring Bruno's shape.

notes: This block can live in the same file as the app-with-ui shape if one product has both a UI and an API collection.
